mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ifj_event_wait (id, instance_id, root_instance_id, attempt_no, wait_type, status, event_code, business_key, correlation_key, accept_after, timeout_at, matched_event_id, allowed_operator_ids, decision_by, decision_comment, resolved_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{instanceId}, #{rootInstanceId}, #{attemptNo}, #{waitType}, #{status}, #{eventCode}, #{businessKey}, #{correlationKey}, #{acceptAfter}, #{timeoutAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{matchedEventId}, #{allowedOperatorIds}, #{decisionBy}, #{decisionComment}, #{resolvedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
INSERT INTO ifj_event_wait_operator (wait_id, operator_id, create_time) VALUES (#{waitId}, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND attempt_no = #{attemptNo}
mapper.sql: task_snapshot.name AS task_name, execution.target_id AS task_id, execution.task_definition_id, wait_record.attempt_no, CASE WHEN root_execution.target_type = 'JOB' THEN root_job.name WHEN root_execution.target_type = 'TASK' THEN root_task.name ELSE NULL END AS root_target_name

LEFT JOIN ifj_instance execution ON execution.id = wait_record.instance_id LEFT JOIN ifj_task_definition task_snapshot ON task_snapshot.id = execution.task_definition_id LEFT JOIN ifj_instance root_execution ON root_execution.id = wait_record.root_instance_id LEFT JOIN ifj_job_definition root_job ON root_job.id = root_execution.definition_id LEFT JOIN ifj_task_definition root_task ON root_task.id = root_execution.task_definition_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait wait_record
WHERE wait_record.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE status = 'WAITING' AND wait_type = 'EVENT' AND event_code = #{eventCode} AND accept_after <= #{arrivedAt} AND (business_key IS NULL OR business_key = #{businessKey}) AND (correlation_key IS NULL OR correlation_key = #{correlationKey}) ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE status = 'WAITING' AND wait_type = 'EVENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_event event_record WHERE event_record.event_code = ifj_event_wait.event_code AND event_record.arrived_at >= ifj_event_wait.accept_after AND (ifj_event_wait.business_key IS NULL OR event_record.business_key = ifj_event_wait.business_key) AND (ifj_event_wait.correlation_key IS NULL OR event_record.correlation_key = ifj_event_wait.correlation_key) ) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE status = 'WAITING' AND wait_type = 'EVENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_event event_record WHERE event_record.event_code = ifj_event_wait.event_code AND event_record.arrived_at >= ifj_event_wait.accept_after AND (ifj_event_wait.business_key IS NULL OR event_record.business_key = ifj_event_wait.business_key) AND (ifj_event_wait.correlation_key IS NULL OR event_record.correlation_key = ifj_event_wait.correlation_key) ) ORDER BY id ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE root_instance_id = #{rootInstanceId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM ifj_event_wait WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT w.root_instance_id FROM ifj_event_wait w JOIN ifj_instance i ON i.id = w.root_instance_id WHERE w.status <> 'WAITING' AND i.status = 'WAITING_EVENT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ifj_event_wait pending WHERE pending.root_instance_id = w.root_instance_id AND pending.status = 'WAITING' ) ORDER BY w.root_instance_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM (
